note: Cases tests/conformance/quarantine.json admits we format differently from the oracle. The manifest shrinks when a gap is fixed and grows when one is accepted; this pin makes both a deliberate, reviewable edit. Move it in the SAME commit that moves the manifest, and say which issue the move belongs to. 171 -> 160 is issue #12: explicit ordered list markers are parsed, so the eleven cases whose ordered lists folded into a paragraph now agree with the oracle. 160 -> 103 is issue #18 (the document header): 55 cases whose only divergence was the blank line the formatter inserted between the title and the author line, plus one #9 case and one untriaged case the same read fixed. 103 -> 97 is issue #24 (attribute entry line continuation): the six cases whose continued value became body text now agree with the oracle. 97 -> 95 is issue #21 (YAML front matter): the two cases whose front matter reflowed into a paragraph now come back byte for byte. The third front-matter case stays, relabelled #23: with no closing fence there is no front matter under any reading, and what diverges is the Markdown thematic break. 95 -> 94 is the comparison lens reading a lone tab as the space it renders as (tests/helpers.ts): the tab-expansion case's only divergence was a lens artifact, and the semantic-fidelity check now agrees with what a reader sees. 94 -> 83 is issue #9 (description lists): a description is an item whose recorded lines are written back, so the eleven cases whose descriptions were reflowed as paragraphs now agree with the oracle. 83 -> 82 is issue #23 (Markdown thematic breaks): the front-matter case with no closing fence reads its opening `---` as the break the oracle reads, so its only divergence is gone. 82 -> 19 is issue #16 (underlined section titles): sixty-three cases whose two-line titles were read as a paragraph over a delimited block, which swallowed the rest of the document, now agree with the oracle - the last three of them because an underlined DOCTITLE keeps its underline, which is what leaves compat mode on (DocumentHeaderNode.underline, src/ast.ts).
